correctness.rationale: Reconstructed y=1-1/x conjugacy to F_A(y)=y-A+A/y and positivity of relevant y for A in (1,4). Substitution gives period-three sextic P_A with discriminant 5184*A^15*(A-3)^3*(A^2-3*A+3)^2; exact symbolic re-evaluation confirms discriminant and factorization P_3=3*(y^3-6y^2+9y-3)^2. A=1 excludes positive cycles; nonzero discriminant propagates root count to A<3, A=4 has six positive simple roots and continuation gives exactly two cycles for A>3. Invariance of the two orbit cubics gives multipliers 1+2(A-3)^2 +/-2A sqrt(A(A-3)), and uniqueness of the flip root follows from strictly decreasing 1-27d-25d^2-9d^3. For A>=3 an invariant compact interval contains a 3-cycle, allowing Sharkovskii forcing; finite tests alone are not the all-period proof.
residual_risks: Finite algebraic/numerical checks are supplemental and do not independently certify the quantified proof.
